fields.summary_ko.0: Dell Technologies Inc. (DELL), headquartered in Round Rock, Texas, designs, manufactures, and sells servers, storage, networking, PCs and peripherals through its Infrastructure Solution Group (ISG) and Client Solution Group (CSG).
fields.summary_ko.1: The company supplies AI-optimized servers, hyperconverged infrastructure, software-defined storage and serves enterprises, government agencies, educational institutions, and small-to-medium businesses.
